OBUIAPP_PROCESS.NAME: Task Type Match
OBUIAPP_PROCESS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically processes Debezium Kafka events to evaluate table rules and create tasks in Etendo ERP based on filters and advanced logic.
OBUIAPP_PROCESS.HELP:
This action is automatically triggered by Debezium events captured from the database and published to Kafka. It is part of the Etendo ERP integration framework that allows real-time processing of database changes.
When a Debezium event (insert, update, or delete) is received, the action: - Parses the event to identify the affected table and operation type. - Retrieves the configured rules for the corresponding table and event. - Evaluates optional filters written in JEXL expressions. - Executes advanced logic processes if defined (OBUIAPP-based). - Creates a new task in the system if all validation steps pass.
The created task is assigned to the initial state defined in the task type. If no rules match or validation fails, no task is created. This process is not executed manually. It is invoked internally by the Kafka event processing mechanism. Proper configuration of table rules and task types is required.
